purpose: Teach: 強姦/使徒/於い/草子/罎/謂/廣/來

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、性暴力、つまり強姦被害の方への診療を医療チームで丁寧におこないます
lines.en: Ren—we'll provide careful, coordinated care for sexual violence survivors as a medical team.
lines.style: Steady, professional opening. Respect in the pacing. No flinch, no softening—direct but humane. Eye-level delivery.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療使徒、つまり奉仕的医療従事者の歴史を医療チームで学びます
lines.en: Ren—we'll study the history of medical practitioners and their tradition of service as a team.
lines.style: Thoughtful, measured pace. Slight weight on the historical aspect. Teaching tone, not lecturing. Grounded.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、感染症蔓延下に於いて、医療チームで体制を整えます
lines.en: Ren—during pandemic conditions, we'll prepare our medical team infrastructure together.
lines.style: Clear and practical. No drama. Steady tempo. Conviction that preparation is possible. Organizational clarity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療の古文献、つまり古典医学草子を医療チームで紐解きます
lines.en: Ren—we'll carefully study the classical medical texts and old documents as a team.
lines.style: Respectful reverence for the old texts. Slightly slower pace on the historical reference. Scholarly warmth without pretension.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、薬剤の旧瓶、つまり罎の保管を医療チームで配慮します
lines.en: Ren—we'll ensure proper storage and care of older medications as a medical team.
lines.style: Practical, attentive to detail. Quiet emphasis on responsibility. Methodical pacing. The care that prevents harm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、所謂、つまり謂わゆる難病の対応を医療チームで検討します
lines.en: Ren—we'll discuss how to handle rare and difficult diseases as a team.
lines.style: Measured, problem-solving tone. No avoidance of complexity. Steady confidence that these are discussable.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、廣域、つまり旧字廣の災害医療連携を医療チームで構築します
lines.en: Ren—we'll build broad disaster-response medical networks and coordination across our team.
lines.style: Expansive but organized. Slightly elevated pace reflecting scale. Vision and preparation balanced. Leadership clarity.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、來院、つまり来院患者の動線を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren—we'll streamline how patients flow through our care pathway as a team.
lines.style: Practical, slightly closer. Warm precision. The care in small logistics. Quieter on the close—intimate professionalism.
